Protests Erupt Over India's Voter Roll Revisions

Protests have broken out in India's capital city concerning revisions to the voter roll. A U.S. student group has expressed support for these protests and raised questions about the voter roll revisions, while also calling for the exit of the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC). The protests are being described as a manifestation of India's democratic strength through 'million mutinies'.
